title: coolboxr
text: coolbox_decision_tree() Gini entropy splitting plus max-depth control integer-valued features. coolbox_svm() linear, RBF, polynomial, sigmoid kernels. coolbox_bayesian_network() plus helpers DAG construction, CPT setup, exact inference, joint-probability queries. coolbox_hmm() parameter management, Baum-Welch training, forward log-likelihood, Viterbi decoding. coolbox_linear_regression() wraps existing CoolBox linear regression implementation. coolbox_multi_arm_bandit() arm simulations pull statistics. coolbox_marked_point_process() marked temporal events, Hawkes-style excitation, intensity prediction, sequence generation. coolbox_pcim() non-stationary piecewise conditional intensity models, interval creation, regime-aware intensity estimation, information criteria. coolbox_latent_sentiment_analysis() matrix-factorization-based sentiment modeling. coolbox_svd(), coolbox_pca(), coolbox_knn(), coolbox_umap() dimensionality reduction nearest-neighbor workflows. coolbox_time_series_summary() exposes descriptive statistics autocorrelation helpers CoolBox time-series library. coolbox_time_series_transform() exposes common native transforms normalization, differencing, moving averages, smoothing, resampling. coolbox_time_series_forecast() wraps native moving-average, exponential-smoothing, autoregressive forecasters. coolbox_time_series_outliers() exposes native z-score IQR outlier detection helpers.
